From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Pierre Dubois <pierre.dubois@falkenhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@falkenhealth.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec briefing cadence + mutual action plan for accelerated close

Team / Pierre —

Putting a consolidated proposal on the table so we can lock the EB (executive briefing) cadence and a mutual action plan (MAP) that lines up with Falken’s evaluation sprint and procurement timeline. Goal: firm close by 2026-07-15.

Attached: MAP_v2.xlsx (action items + owners), EB_invite_draft.ics (placeholder), EB_pre-read_v1.pdf (draft). I also exported an initial exec roster as exec_roster.csv — see Marissa’s note below for recommended owners.

Key asks:
- Internal: confirm which Redwood execs will own each EB slot (sales exec sponsor, engineering lead, security/ops brief).
- For Falken: confirm which exec will attend each EB (CEO/CTO/CFO) and any calendar conflicts for the week of July 6–10 (we're proposing the first EB during that window).
- Everyone: review MAP success criteria section (tab 2 of MAP_v2) and flag any missing acceptance criteria by EOD Tue, Jun 23.

Proposed cadence (sketch):
1) EB #0 (intro + alignment) — week of July 6 — 45 min — attendees: Redwood sales + product execs, Falken exec sponsor(s).
2) EB #1 (technical canary + acceptance criteria) — week of July 13 — 60 min — deeper run + ops checklist.
3) Close / procurement sync — targeted by Jul 15.

Notes: MAP_v2 has two parallel tracks — evaluation (technical + UX) and procurement (contracts + security/compliance). I’d like us to identify the Redwood owner for procurement handoff now so nothing slips the week of close.

Next steps: please review and reply with availability and owners. Pierre — if the proposed weeks look off for you, let us know preferred dates.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Director, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (Excel, 42KB), EB_invite_draft.ics (calendar invite), EB_pre-read_v1.pdf (PDF, 380KB)

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec briefing cadence + mutual action plan for accelerated close

Thanks Vanessa — quick notes from pre-sales perspective:
- Recommend we add Falken CFO to EB #0 if procurement will be discussed; getting the CFO in early reduces pricing pushback later.
- For the evaluation week I suggest we make the canary week July 6–9 and reserve July 10 for a readiness checkpoint (gives us a buffer before EB #1).
- Acceptance criteria: add a short list (3 bullets) for perf SLOs in MAP_v2 tab "Success criteria" — I can draft today if you want.

Linking the HubSpot deal for timeline context: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/14782

Cheers,
Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer

Confirming I can take the engineering sponsor slot.
- I reviewed the MAP_v2 canary plan — recommend we measure three quick signals during the canary: 95th p99 latency for 2k token prompts, throughput at 50 concurrent sessions, and token-level cost delta against baseline. I added these into the "Success criteria" section (see MAP_v2 tab).
- July 6–9 for the canary works for Eng; I'd prefer the EB #0 be July 7 (mid-week) to give the Falken team a chance to settle after the holiday week.

I forwarded the EB invite (EB_invite_draft.ics) to calendar and will accept once ice-break attendees are finalized.
